description: This file defines the ModelEntity class, which models an <entity> element in the OFBiz framework. It contains information about entity metadata, fields, relations, indexes, and methods for managing and accessing this metadata, supporting entity configuration and code generation.

classes.name: ModelEntity
classes.description: Represents an entity model in OFBiz, encapsulating entity metadata including fields, relations, indexes, and configuration options. Implements comparison based on entity name and provides methods for managing metadata and generating code snippets.

methods.name: populateBasicInfo
methods.description: Populates core entity attributes from the XML element such as entity name, table name, package name, and configuration flags.

methods.name: populateRelated
methods.description: Populates the list of relations for this entity from child XML elements.

methods.name: populateIndexes
methods.description: Populates index metadata from XML configuration.

methods.name: addExtendEntity
methods.description: Extends or overrides entity configuration and fields based on external XML definitions.

methods.name: convertFieldMapInPlace
methods.description: Converts all fields in a map in place based on the entity's field types.

methods.name: convertFieldValue
methods.description: Converts a field value to the appropriate Java type based on the model field and delegator.

methods.name: convertFieldValue (overloaded)
methods.description: Converts a field value considering locale and timezone from the given context.

methods.name: getAuthor
methods.description: Returns the author from the entity's metadata.

methods.name: getCopyright
methods.description: Returns the copyright information from the entity's metadata.

methods.name: getDefaultResourceName
methods.description: Returns the default resource name associated with this entity.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the entity.

methods.name: getRelations
methods.description: Returns the list of relations for this entity.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title for this entity.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version of this entity.

methods.name: toXmlElement
methods.description: Serializes the entity into an XML element, including fields, indexes, relations, and metadata attributes.

methods.name: toGroupXmlElement
methods.description: Creates an XML element representing the entity group for packaging.

methods.name: writeEoModelText
methods.description: Exports entity model information to the Apple EOModelBundle format.

methods.name: createEoModelMap
methods.description: Generates a map of entity attributes suitable for EOModel export, including fields, relationships, and indexes.
